pendingRetry.fate: Pause receipt observed before the selected retry deadline. An ordinary restore of the stopped source reproduces the pre-pause handler ledger without added rows or counters; after retirement the old namespace remains unused and its bytes stay unchanged.

assertionBasis: Control refusals, namespace allocation and recovery gates are assertions in the fingerprinted driver. The curator independently checks recorded hold data, source pins and prefix hashes. Row fingerprints are computed over retained private rows; an empty survivor set covers startup and retained-prefix isolation rather than live application rows. Manifest identifiers refer to private full manifests, not their public projections. Terminal exit codes are operator observations.
limits: Stopped full-installation copies; same runtime image and two application fleets only
Retained source volumes and old namespaces can run old work if restarted; keep them stopped
Pause clears timer/retry identity and is not a callback drain or a missed-tick backlog
Independent local fixtures do not qualify hostile tenants, remote hosts, Kubernetes or three-fleet cron recovery
Live cron work used the archived private qualification controller; ordinary startup ran only after every live cron was retired
Operator explicitly selected the ordinary controller command after the last live cron was retired
Reuse means slot/capacity reuse under a different app name; the cron replacement reuses the refresh fixture code and refresh-db declaration on a fresh namespace
Retiring cron beside another live cron is not exercised; the bounded profile pairs cron with queued work
Gate 7 was qualified at commit 63fb494; a full current-tree recovery rerun remains required before normal cron admission
Normal scoped cron admission, release-bound runtime qualification and upstream Rust execution remain open; watchdogs do not qualify CPU limits
queuedSurvivorVerification: GET-only completion checks after recovery acknowledgment and separate resume; original inputs were POSTed once before the snapshot.

retrySourceLedgerAudit.limit: Archived ledger equality measures handler outcomes across pause and shutdown; it does not establish a universal callback drain or an observation-only dispatch fence.

sourceVolumeComparisonBasis: Fingerprint-pinned driver assertions compare every archived source entry and complete names after shutdown; manifest archive hashes and compared volume names are published for each case.
